title: Second Eigenvalue Estimates and Spectral Rigidity for Submanifolds of Compact Rank-One Symmetric Spaces
summary: In this paper, we establish upper bounds for the second eigenvalue of the Schrödinger operator $L=Δ+|σ|^2+k$ on $k$-dimensional closed submanifolds of the compact projective spaces $\mathbb F P^m$, where $\mathbb F\in\{\mathbb R,\mathbb C,\mathbb H\}$, as well as the Cayley projective plane. The estimates are obtained by combining the standard spherical embeddings of these spaces with a conformal test-function argument.
